title: Pizza alla Funghi (Mushroom Pizza)

ingredients.title: Dough (Classic Neapolitan Style)
items: 250 g (2 cups) “00” flour (or strong bread flour)

ingredients.title: Toppings
items: 150 g (5 oz) fresh mozzarella (preferably fior di latte or bufala), drained and torn
200 g (7 oz) fresh mushrooms (mixed porcini, cremini, and champignons for depth), thinly sliced
30 g (2 tbsp) Parmigiano Reggiano, freshly grated
Salt & freshly ground black pepper to taste

ingredients.title: Optional Finishing
items: Truffle oil (few drops, optional but elevates to fine-dining level)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Dough
steps: In a bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in water. Let sit 5 minutes until slightly foamy.
Mix in flour and salt, knead until a smooth dough forms (~10 minutes by hand, 5 minutes with mixer).
Add olive oil and knead until elastic and glossy.
Cover and rest for 1–2 hours, or until doubled in size.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Mushrooms
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic, sauté until fragrant (not browned).
Add mushrooms, season lightly with salt and pepper. Cook 3–4 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Add thyme leaves, toss, and set aside to cool slightly.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to its highest setting (250°C / 480°F) with a pizza stone or steel if available.
Stretch dough gently into a 12-inch circle.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Bake
steps: Transfer to preheated stone/steel and bake 6–8 minutes, until crust is puffed and charred in spots, cheese melted and bubbling.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Finish & Serve
steps: Drizzle with a touch of truffle oil (optional).
Slice and serve immediately while hot.

chefTips: Mushroom mix: Porcini add earthiness, cremini for body, champignon for freshness.
Cheese balance: Avoid overloading mozzarella—less is more for proper melt and flavor clarity.
Stone-baking: A hot stone or steel ensures authentic restaurant-quality blistered crust.
Pairing: Best enjoyed with a glass of Chianti or Barbera red wine.
